# Hyperbase / Chrome Components

Reusable shadcn Base UI patterns for Hypercanvas. Review the navigation states, then interact with dialogs, menus and panels. Change the canvas theme to review light and dark.

The canvas, widgets and toolbars retain their existing UI.

## Dialogs, menus and side panels

Open, dismiss and use the controls. Review alternate exports from the component source: **Active**, **Empty**, **Narrow**. Each overlay stays inside its own document.

## Transfer into the app

Compositions accept data and action callbacks. Move the approved composition and its shadcn dependencies into Core, then connect callbacks to existing actions. Keep stories here as the review reference.

Styles belong to their document. App CSS must never be imported by prototype or story entries.

Any action taken on multi-selection. Right now, the only one available is change color on the widgets, but those should be applied as a batch, right? Right now, I'm having to like undo each widget, sticky note color change one by one after doing a multi-select color change. Also, multi-selection are still not draggable from the middle. I need to be able to get any of the widgets inside of the multi-selection and drag them away. This is especially important because most multi-selections can be huge
